mapper.select: WITH plans AS ( SELECT s.*, p.cust_ptnr_id, p.indty_cd, p.prj_nm, coalesce((SELECT sum(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.prj_id=s.prj_id AND a.job_cd=s.job_cd AND m.work_ym=s.plan_ym AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED'),0) AS assigned_mm, coalesce(sum(s.need_mm_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY s.prj_id,s.plan_ym,s.job_cd ORDER BY s.grd_cd,s.psn_plan_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) AS preceding_mm FROM prj.psn_plan s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN') AND s.plan_ym >= #{month} ), vacant AS ( SELECT *, greatest(0,need_mm_qty-greatest(0,assigned_mm-preceding_mm)) AS vacant_mm FROM plans ), options AS ( SELECT 'PROJECT'::text AS source_type,psn_plan_id AS row_id,prj_id AS project_id,NULL::bigint AS need_id, job_cd AS job_code,nullif(grd_cd,'') AS grade_code,plan_ym AS start_ym,1 AS duration_months, ceil(vacant_mm)::integer AS remaining_headcount,round(vacant_mm/ceil(vacant_mm),2) AS requested_mm, cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,indty_cd AS industry_code,prj_nm AS label FROM vacant WHERE vacant_mm>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'OPP',n.need_id,NULL::bigint,n.need_id,n.job_cd,n.grd_cd,n.bgn_ym,n.mnth_qty, n.psn_cnt-(SELECT count(*)::integer FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t WHERE t.need_id=n.need_id AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'), n.mth_mm_qty,o.cust_ptnr_id,c.indty_cd,o.oppt_nm FROM bsn.oppt_need n JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=o.cust_ptnr_id WHERE o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' AND n.use_yn='Y' AND n.mnth_qty BETWEEN 1 AND 36 AND n.mth_mm_qty BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.00 AND to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM')+(n.mnth_qty-1)*interval '1 month','YYYY-MM') >= #{month} AND n.psn_cnt > (SELECT count(*) FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t WHERE t.need_id=n.need_id AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE') ) SELECT * FROM options WHERE position(lower(#{search}) in lower(label))>0 OR position(lower(#{search}) in lower(job_code))>0 ORDER BY source_type,row_id
SELECT k.skl_cd FROM prj.psn_plan s JOIN prj.prj_skl k ON k.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE #{sourceType}='PROJECT' AND s.psn_plan_id=#{rowId} ORDER BY k.skl_cd

SELECT d.dev_id,a.end_dt AS exit_date,NULL::text AS assumed_exit_ym,a.ext_psblty_cd AS extension_likelihood, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn n WHERE n.dev_id=d.dev_id AND n.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND (a.asgn_id IS NULL OR n.asgn_id!=a.asgn_id) AND n.end_dt>coalesce(a.end_dt,#{today})) AS has_next FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.asgn_id,x.end_dt,x.ext_psblty_cd FROM asgn.asgn x WHERE x.dev_id=d.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND x.bgn_dt<=#{today} AND x.end_dt>=#{today} ORDER BY x.end_dt DESC,x.asgn_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) a ON true WHERE d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt>=#{today})
AND d.dev_id=#{devId} AND (a.end_dt IS NULL OR a.end_dt<=#{until})
AND (position(lower(#{search}) in lower(d.main_job_cd))>0 OR position(lower(#{search}) in lower(d.grd_cd))>0) ORDER BY a.end_dt NULLS LAST,d.dev_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{devId} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT d.dtl_cd FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY d.sort_seq,d.dtl_cd
